scripts.ingest:fetch: cd services/ingest-py && uv run python scripts/fetch_pdfs.py
scripts.ingest:extract: cd services/ingest-py && uv run python scripts/extract_pdfs.py
scripts.ingest:chunk: cd services/ingest-py && uv run python scripts/chunk_pdfs.py
scripts.ingest:embed: cd services/ingest-py && uv run python scripts/embed_chunks.py
scripts.ingest:load: cd services/ingest-py && uv run python scripts/load_to_db.py
scripts.ingest:all: pnpm ingest:fetch && pnpm ingest:extract && pnpm ingest:chunk && pnpm ingest:embed && pnpm ingest:load
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U vat_user -d vat_db
